typography.strategy: System fonts tailored for native platforms (San Francisco on iOS, Roboto on Android) to ensure an enterprise-grade, native feel.

buttons.primary: bg-[#0F4C81] rounded-lg min-h-[48px] items-center justify-center shadow-sm
buttons.secondary: bg-white border border-[#0F4C81] rounded-lg min-h-[48px] items-center justify-center

inputs.text: bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-lg h-12 px-4 text-base text-slate-800 focus:border-[#0F4C81] focus:border-2

cards.metric_widget: bg-white p-4 rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-slate-200 flex-1
cards.list_item: bg-white p-4 rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-slate-200 mb-3 flex-row items-center

scanner.overlay: bg-black/70 absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center
scanner.scan_box: w-64 h-64 border-2 border-[#16A34A] rounded-2xl relative

offline_indicator.banner: bg-amber-100 flex-row px-4 py-2 items-center justify-center border-b border-amber-200

icons.library: @expo/vector-icons (Feather or Ionicons preferred for enterprise apps)

navigation.strategy: File-based routing using expo-router. Use a Stack for auth, and Tabs for the main app, with nested Stacks for details.

testing_attributes.rule: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute.

login_background.description: Modern warehouse interior. Use with a dark or blue overlay (bg-black/50 or bg-[#0F4C81]/70) behind the login form.

mock_product_1.description: Cardboard boxes for mock inventory item lists.

mock_product_2.description: High stacks of cardboard boxes for product details placeholder.

implementation_instructions_for_main_age: Use expo-router for file-based routing. Group tabs under a '(tabs)' folder.
All files must have .js extensions (not .tsx) as requested.
Implement the offline indicator globally (e.g., in the _layout.js file of the tabs).
The Scanner screen should be a mock view. Build a UI that looks like a camera view using a dark background, a frame, and an animated laser line.
Sync Screen is admin-only and should list pending items with 'Approve' and 'Reject' actions.
Ensure all text is in Spanish.
Use @expo/vector-icons (Feather or Ionicons). Do not use emojis.
Maintain the professional blue/gray enterprise palette across all components.
